evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never frames the call as 10–15 minutes with a dependable quote and doesn't wait for a yes. Jumps directly into 'do you have any questions or concerns you would like answered on this call?' without time-boxing or the promise framing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. Rep states 'besides pricing, do you have any questions or concerns you would like answered on this call?' but this is phrased as a narrow yes/no, and the customer answers 'No, I just wanted to get a quote on moving some stuff to an apartment.' No genuine open-ended discovery of their underlying concerns.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer raised no concerns to follow up on.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns were raised, so no reflection was needed or possible.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (house/apartment), floor/stories (first floor at origin, fifth floor with elevator at destination), number of rooms (one bedroom equivalent, partial move), walking distance (short, truck can park close), additional rooms (secretary desk, small bookshelf, safe), special considerations (safe weighing ~335 lbs, lift-gate truck needed, door removable). Box count also checked. All seven logistics items covered or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not offered. Rep never asks 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes, asked as 'typical move for the say one bedroom is about fifteen to 25 boxes. Do you feel like you'll fall within that range or have less?'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full. Rep gives typical range ('between two and a half, three and a half hours') and anchors pricing ('between $480 and... $672'), and personalizes to customer's minimal move: 'since you're just moving the minimal amount of items I believe that this move would probably just take about the two and a half hours.' Later adjusts for Sunday rate ($510 vs. weekday $190–$192).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full. Rep discloses 'There is no deposit required to get on our schedule and then there's no fees are charges to change or cancel.' Explains '2.5 hour minimum once we go over that minimum the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments.' Frames prep as key factor ('the most important one is how well prepared you are when we get there').
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or any variant, and does not pause for customer reflection after the pricing.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full. Rep states 'we do have an on time guarantee we value your time. So, if we can't make it in the time window that we arrange, we made at least start discounting money of your final bill.' Discount framing is present.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Full. Rep states 'We have a no worries damage coverage which is a free evaluation coverage included in our hourly rate and that provides up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for accidental damages.' No deductible and no fine-print framing; coverage is built in.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: False. Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent, and neither does she revisit or confirm that both promises are understood by the customer.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Throwaway. Rep asks 'Alright and then do you have any questions? Other questions for me' — this is the empty automatic 'any questions' variant, not a genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: False. Rep never asks 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or similar.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Full. Rep asks plainly 'would you like us to help you with that move?' without a built-in out. Customer says yes via booking confirmation.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: True. Rep states 'There is no deposit required to get on our schedule and then there's no fees are charges to change or cancel for that timeframe of a move,' implying the rate is locked.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Full. Date confirmed (eleventh, Sunday), arrival window confirmed (12:30–2:00 PM), addresses confirmed (106 Adam Lane to 4200 Scotland Street, Unit 502), crew details (2 movers, lift-gate truck with removable door noted for the safe). Phone number already on file. Special notes left for movers about the safe and door removal.

top_strength: Brianne gathered detailed logistics efficiently—property types, floor levels, elevator access, parking, safe specifications, and box estimates—all of which directly support accurate pricing and crew readiness.
coaching_note: Section 2 (Their Agenda) was skipped entirely; Brianne should open with 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move, and what do you want answers to on this call?' before jumping into logistics probing, and Section 6 needs a genuine 'What's still concerning you?' not an automatic 'any other questions?'
